errors.text_span: Процентните стойности са показани както вътре в секциите, така и до тях.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the percentage values are shown both inside and next to the sections. The values (12,39 % and 87,61 %) are only shown outside the pie slices.
The description fails to mention that the chart is a 3D pie chart, which is a distinct visual characteristic.
